lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in several vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The pattern transitions from larger, discrete high-luminance nodes in the anterior flank to smaller, more densely packed clusters as the flank tapers posteriorly towards the left of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, creating a grid-like alignment particularly visible in the mid-flank region where vertical columns of spots reside on these intensity bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.
